steps.message: Review shift swap requests in 'shift-requests' channel. Check the Calendar for any conflicts on the requested dates. If there is a conflict (e.g. 'All Hands' or 'Training'), reply to the request in the channel with 'Denied: [Reason]'. If there is no conflict, forward the request via email to 'hr@company.com' with subject 'Shift Swap Request' and reply to the user 'Request escalated to HR'.
